field.label: Subnet
field.help: Kea DHCPv6 subnet to enable DDNS for.

field.label: Forward zone
field.help: Forward DNS zone for this subnet.

field.label: Qualifying suffix
field.help: FQDN suffix appended to hostnames (e.g. casa.dyn.example.com.). Must end with a dot.

field.label: Send updates
field.help: Enable sending DDNS updates for this subnet.

field.label: Update on renew
field.help: Send DNS updates when leases are renewed.

field.label: Replace client name
field.help: Controls whether Kea replaces the client-sent FQDN. 'Always' is recommended for DHCPv6 since clients typically send full FQDNs.

field.label: Conflict resolution
field.help: How to resolve DNS conflicts using DHCID records.

field.label: Rapid commit
field.help: Enable DHCPv6 Rapid Commit (RFC 8415). Required for macOS clients.

field.label: Generated prefix
field.help: Prefix for auto-generated hostnames when replacing client name (default: myhost).
